title: Mixed Event — Scramble Fan Festival! — Episode2 Let's Go Together!

meta.Event Outline: Minori, Ichika, Kohane and Nene are all set to sing in the annual VIRTUAL SINGER Fan Festival. Kanade and the rest of N25 also attend, keen to witness their favorite creators. The curtains rise, uniting heartfelt emotions into a grand symphony!

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What? You want to participate in the VIRTUAL SINGER Fan Festival?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, and it sounds like they still have some open slots for amateur performers!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'd really like to join but...
What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I don't see why not.
It's a good opportunity to sing in front of a crowd.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's true.
But I'm still pretty startled by this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What brought you to this decision?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Um...
It's because your performance was so good, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is about me?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! You shined and sparkled on stage at that elementary school... So I decided that I wanna do that too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I'm not nearly as good as you are at singing and dancing... Even then, I need to become more independent and learn to perform on stage by myself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me participating in this Fan Festival is a part of that! I want to get better!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Practicing to learn to perform on stage all by yourself. That's very admirable of you♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I agree, but I also feel like you're diving head first into the deep end with the Fan Festival...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-You think so...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She may be right. Especially considering how many people attend each year.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. Some say that more people gather here than for some of the bigger idol events.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: E-Eep...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. At the same time, it's important to take on new challenges.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I think so too.
And I have a feeling that you'll be just fine, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Geez, you're so easy.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But since you've decided to take the stage like this, make sure to send everyone home smiling.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I'm sure she will. You have our support, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks, Airi, Shizuku...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm with them.
Break a leg, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, but don't push yourself too hard and actually do that. We still need you back in one piece.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, Haruka, I promise to be careful!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You can do it, Minori!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We'll be rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, I'm gonna keep trying more and more in preparation for this event!
bgm_area00003
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
A Fan Festival?
What's that like?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
A friend of mine told me about it.
It's an event where Miku artists and creators gather to do shows and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm thinking about participating in it with this friend, who's in a band, and this other friend, who's an idol.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, that sounds pretty fun!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But what made you want to participate in this event?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Well, it's a chance for me to expand my horizons in terms of music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Expand your horizons?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: When I went to the Seaside School, my group decided to sing a piece from this one musical.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It was so different from what we usually sing, but I learned so many new things and really grew as a singer because of it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I have a feeling that I'll make some new discoveries by participating in this event.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Remember how a song by Rin and Len became the reason why I'd become interested in music?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If you weren't there singing that song that time, I probably wouldn't have wandered into this wonderful world...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This event would sort of be my way of giving back and showing my appreciation.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Why not?
Like Kohane says, sometimes you have to switch things up to experience new things.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I agree.
It's important to take on new challenges like this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I say go for it.
The Summer Festival definitely taught us a thing or two about trying something new.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It really did.
Not only that, this is a rare opportunity to sing with people other than us.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Good for you, Kohane!
It sounds like you have their blessing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you so much!
Shinonome, Aoyagi, I don't know what to say!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, of course...!
I can't wait to see you knock everyone's socks off at this event!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Right! Thanks, An!
I promise to do my best!
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A VIRTUAL SINGER fan appreciation event? And you're gonna be in it, Hoshino...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It'll be me and two other girls from my school, but we're coming from very different groups.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A Fan Festival, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I need to keep working on my singing to make my own dreams come true...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Say, Hoshino, are there still spots open for that event?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, I think so...
Does that mean you'd like to join us?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. This feels like something I need to do. You know, to help make my dreams come true...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I have to keep getting better and gain experience singing on my own.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, I see. You're more than welcome to join us...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, why don't we all have a practice session together? It'd even be a great chance to introduce you to Minori and Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
I hope we get along...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Don't worry, they're both really nice.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
I'll join you all for practice.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Hoshino's friends, huh? I wonder what they're like...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I sort of can't wait to meet them.)
